steps: Drain and rinse the soaked rajma, then pressure cook it in fresh water with a little salt for 15 to 20 minutes, until a bean mashes easily.
Heat the oil in a pan and let the cumin seeds sizzle.
Add the onion and fry until golden brown.
Stir in the ginger, garlic and green chilli for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and the spice powders, and cook until the masala thickens and the oil separates.
Tip in the cooked rajma with its cooking water and the rest of the salt, and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, mashing a few beans to thicken it.
Stir in the crushed kasuri methi, the ghee and the coriander leaves, then serve with rice.
note: Sources used 40 to 60 g of dry rajma a serving, and 50 g is the middle. Cream is optional in every source and is left out; one source cooks in butter, so oil with a spoon of ghee is used instead.
